title: Chick reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- Chick body -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="72" rx="22" ry="20" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  <!-- Chick wing left -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="70" rx="8" ry="12" fill="#FFB800" transform="rotate(20 28 70)"/>
  <!-- Chick wing right -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="70" rx="8" ry="12" fill="#FFB800" transform="rotate(-20 62 70)"/>
  <!-- Chick head -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="40" r="18" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  <!-- Chick belly -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="78" rx="13" ry="10" fill="#FFF3B0"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="38" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="38" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="39" cy="38" r="2.5" fill="#2D2D6B"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="38" r="2.5" fill="#2D2D6B"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="37" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="37" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <polygon points="45,45 41,50 49,50" fill="#FF8C42"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="45" r="3" fill="#FF9F9F" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="45" r="3" fill="#FF9F9F" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Head tuft -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="23" rx="4" ry="6" fill="#FFB800"/>
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="21" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#FFD93D" transform="rotate(-15 42 21)"/>
  <ellipse cx="49" cy="21" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#FFD93D" transform="rotate(15 49 21)"/>
  <!-- Book left page -->
  <polygon points="30,60 45,58 45,85 30,87" fill="#E8F4FD"/>
  <polygon points="30,60 45,58 45,85 30,87" fill="#D0E8FF" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- Book right page -->
  <polygon points="45,58 60,60 60,87 45,85" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polygon points="45,58 60,60 60,87 45,85" fill="#E8F4FD" opacity="0.3"/>
  <!-- Book spine -->
  <line x1="45" y1="58" x2="45" y2="85" stroke="#4A7FB5" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Book text lines left -->
  <line x1="33" y1="64" x2="43" y2="63" stroke="#4A7FB5" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="33" y1="68" x2="43" y2="67" stroke="#4A7FB5" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="33" y1="72" x2="43" y2="71" stroke="#4A7FB5" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="33" y1="76" x2="43" y2="75" stroke="#4A7FB5" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Book text lines right -->
  <line x1="47" y1="63" x2="57" y2="64" stroke="#4A7FB5" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="47" y1="67" x2="57" y2="68" stroke="#4A7FB5" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="47" y1="71" x2="57" y2="72" stroke="#4A7FB5" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="47" y1="75" x2="57" y2="76" stroke="#4A7FB5" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="92" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#FF8C42"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="92" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#FF8C42"/>
</svg>
